scope: Offline survey-completion date distribution and B input-engineering audit; no SCE answer or model outcome analysis
exclusions: Missing completion dates and dates outside their declared survey month are counted separately, never moved. Invalid weights excluded only in weighted sensitivity.
availability: For historical date forecasts at the fifteenth of each target month, source survey month-end plus nine calendar months must be strictly earlier than cutoff. This reproduces the declared B lag assumption, not certified historical bytes.
mapping: Rebin source day probability cells by fractional month overlap onto target day cells, preserving probability mass. Mix historical source months equally; no fitted calendar or weekday effects.
metrics: W1 of completion dates measured in days
share completing strictly after archived CPI release day
weighting: Unweighted completion counts primary; original survey-weighted date distribution sensitivity. Across months equal weight.
sampling_reference: 512 independent draws from each empirical monthly count PMF,500 replications,seed20261026; conditional Monte Carlo scale only, not population confidence intervals or panel-independence inference
decision: Assess effect sizes, historical prediction and information-exposure differences; no optimization on SCE MAE and no production cutoff change
B_inventory: Read-only full-month archived NYT/basic-topic-label coverage check. No tagging, dispatch, new authorization or response regeneration.
